decisions.reason: The existing message-53 MODIFY already records selection of the custom-fabricated stainless-steel render-style spout.
The existing message-53 MODIFY already captures both stainless-steel custom fabrication and render fidelity for the spout.
The existing message-53 MODIFY already records the client's render-fidelity decision for the machine's visual identity.
The existing message-53 MODIFY already records the custom-fabricated spout as an exception to the otherwise off-the-shelf V1 sourcing policy.
Accepting the custom-fabricated spout does not change the requirement to deliver a basic wiring plan; specific wiring changes are not necessarily established by the source decision.
The existing message-53 MODIFY already records that the Karla's Matcha Mixer placard must face the customer.
The spout appearance and construction decision neither changes nor removes the existing splash-free mixing target.

The preceding exchange mentions solenoid and button operation, but the immediate proposal accepted by the client concerns fabricating the spout from stainless steel; it is unclear whether message 53 also confirms a new button-operated dispensing mechanism.
Custom stainless-steel spout construction does not alter the existing leak-prevention requirements.
The source decision changes spout construction and appearance but does not change the existing removability or cleaning requirements.
The source decision concerns the spout and placard orientation and does not modify bowl capacity or form.
The request for render fidelity does not explicitly replace or modify the already selected beige and green color scheme.
